document.title: Struchtúr an doiciméid
document.description: Roghnaigh an rannán ar mian leat oibriú air. Fanann faisnéis struchtúrach agus faisnéis faoi réada lasmuigh den limistéar scríbhneoireachta go dtí go mbíonn siad de dhíth.

manuscript.title: Sonraí lámhscríbhinne
manuscript.description: Cuir faisnéis ar leibhéal na lámhscríbhinne in eagar ar leithligh ón limistéar scríbhneoireachta.

tools.title: Easpórtáil agus uirlisí
tools.description: Coinnítear gníomhartha tánaisteacha, teicniúla agus a d’fhéadfadh a bheith millteach lasmuigh den limistéar scríbhneoireachta.
tools.exportDescription: Cruthaigh comhad lámhscríbhinne OMI canónach iniompartha tar éis athruithe ar feitheamh a shábháil mar sheicphointe.

tools.confirmReset: An lámhscríbhinn shamplach reatha a athshocrú? Cuirfear sonraí neamhshábháilte agus sonraí an tsampla reatha ina n-ionad.
tools.technicalDescription: Scrúdaigh an léiriú séimeantach amháin nuair a bhíonn sonraí teicniúla ag teastáil.

settings.title: Socruithe an chomhéadain
settings.description: Roghnaigh na teangacha comhéadain is mian leat a bheith ar fáil agus tú ag obair. Stóráiltear na roghanna ar an ngléas seo.
settings.interfaceLanguagesDescription: Feictear teangacha cumasaithe sa lascóir tapa teanga i gceanntásc an eagarthóra.
settings.currentLanguageHint: Caithfidh an teanga atá in úsáid faoi láthair fanacht cumasaithe. Athraigh go teanga eile sula ndíchumasaítear í.

notes.title: Nótaí

assetContainer.title: OMI package
assetContainer.description: Externalize binary resources and package the manuscript, history, publication profile, checksums, assets and valid JATS output as a portable .omi container.

assetContainer.ready: The container passed Studio integrity checks.
assetContainer.blocked: The package has blocking integrity errors.
assetContainer.privacyNote: Asset-backed image previews are resolved from the local binary repository. Portable manuscript state no longer needs Base64 preview data after externalization.
assetContainer.importDescription: Inspect an untrusted .omi container, verify its manifest, ZIP structure, revision identities, assets and SHA-256 checksums before loading it.
assetContainer.verified: The package passed integrity verification and can be opened.
assetContainer.invalid: The package cannot be opened until its blocking integrity errors are resolved.
assetContainer.imported: The verified OMI manuscript was opened with its original identity and revision history.
assetContainer.replaceWarning: Opening the package replaces the active workspace manuscript. It does not create a new manuscript ID or revision root.

help.title: Help for authors
help.description: A short guide to editing manuscripts and using the main Studio features.
help.gettingStarted: When a manuscript is opened from OJS, Studio imports the document and available publication metadata. Editing then takes place in the Studio manuscript model.

topics.title: Editing the manuscript
topics.body: Edit manuscript text in the main editor. Review its structure under Manuscript menu → Document.
tips: Use real heading styles for section headings.
Do not rely on bold text or font size alone to express structure.

topics.title: Manuscript data and languages
topics.body: Abstracts, keywords and other scholarly metadata are edited under Manuscript data. Multilingual fields can be maintained separately in HU, EN and DE.
tips: The manuscript language and metadata language are separate concepts.
A Hungarian article may also have English and German abstracts and keywords.

topics.title: Notes
topics.body: Footnotes and endnotes are retained as semantic note objects. Review and edit them under Notes.

topics.title: References
topics.body: Cited works are stored as structured bibliographic records. Add a work once and reuse it in multiple citations.

topics.title: Contributors
topics.body: Manage authors and other contributors, roles, affiliations and ORCID identifiers here.

topics.title: Revisions and saving
topics.body: Studio tracks important changes as revisions. Use History to review changes and, where supported, return to an earlier state.

topics.title: Import from OJS
topics.body: Studio can import the document, abstracts, keywords and other publication metadata from OJS. Only metadata actually present in OJS can be imported.

topics.title: DOCX import
topics.body: When importing Word documents, Studio also attempts to recover document structure.
tips: Use Word Heading 1, Heading 2, etc. for section headings.
Direct-formatting recognition is only a fallback.

topics.title: Export
topics.body: Export & tools can create a portable .omi.json manuscript file containing the semantic document structure and OMI metadata.

topics.title: If something looks wrong
topics.body: Check the manuscript language, selected metadata language and, for Word imports, heading styles. For OJS imports, also verify that the value is actually filled in under the OJS Publication metadata.

htmlExport.title: Semantic HTML5
htmlExport.description: Render the semantic manuscript through the active Publication Profile as an accessible, script-free HTML5 scholarly article.
htmlExport.exportReady: The HTML rendering has no blocking diagnostics.
htmlExport.exportHasErrors: The HTML can be inspected, but blocking diagnostics must be resolved before a publication package is created.
htmlExport.workingPreview: The preview reflects the current working state. Package download creates a checkpoint first so the output is traceable to a committed revision.
htmlExport.unsupportedProfile: The active profile does not declare HTML as a supported output.
htmlExport.accessibilityNote: The renderer uses semantic headings, figures, tables, document-note roles, bibliography links and explicit image alt attributes. External accessibility auditing remains a separate publication step.
htmlExport.packageNote: The ZIP package contains index.html, a manifest and referenced media assets under relative media/ paths. No script or external stylesheet is required.

jatsExport.title: JATS XML
jatsExport.description: Render the semantic manuscript through the active Publication Profile as NISO JATS 1.4 Article Authoring XML.
jatsExport.exportReady: The JATS rendering has no blocking diagnostics.
jatsExport.exportHasErrors: The XML can be inspected, but blocking diagnostics must be resolved before publication.
jatsExport.workingPreview: The preview reflects the current working state. Download creates a checkpoint first so the exported XML is traceable to a committed revision.
jatsExport.unsupportedProfile: The active profile does not declare JATS as a supported output.
jatsExport.schemaNote: Studio checks required structure, XML identifiers and internal rid targets. Full external JATS DTD/XSD/RNG validation remains a separate conformance step.
